```yaml
name: ESLint

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]
    paths:
      - '**/*.ts'
      - '**/*.tsx'
      - '**/*.js'
      - '**/*.jsx'
      - '**/.eslintrc.*'
      - '**/package.json'
      - '**/tsconfig.json'

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version-file: .nvmrc
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run ESLint
        run: npm run lint
```

name: ESLint

    paths:

      - '**/*.js'

      - '**/tsconfig.json'

jobs:

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
